requirement_vague: Verify the superuser (admin@example.com / password123) can change their own password and change it back.

implementation.reasoning: The startup logic creates the superuser with email admin@example.com and password password123 if it does not already exist. The login endpoint authenticates credentials and returns an access token, and the authenticated PATCH /users/me/password endpoint allows the current user, including the superuser, to change their own password when the current password matches, returning HTTP 200 with message 'Password updated successfully'; because authentication checks the stored hashed password, logging in with the new password and then reverting back to the original password will succeed.
